title: SSRESF: Sensitivity-aware Single-particle Radiation Effects Simulation Framework in SoC Platforms based on SVM Algorithm
problem: Traditional single-particle radiation effect testing methods are inefficient for large-scale integrated circuits and SoCs. Identifying radiation-sensitive circuit nodes and analyzing soft errors across complex systems requires faster simulation and automated classification approaches.
motivation: Radiation-induced single-event upsets (SEU) and transients (SET) pose significant reliability risks in modern large-scale SoC designs, making efficient simulation and error prediction critical.
method: The framework employs support vector machine (SVM) algorithm to rapidly identify and classify radiation-sensitive circuit nodes in SoCs. It automates soft error analysis across the entire software stack and creates comprehensive databases of SEU and SET effects for different circuit components. The approach is validated on RISC-V architecture covering processor cores, interconnects, and memory subsystems.
key_novelty: Sensitivity-aware automated identification of radiation-vulnerable circuit nodes using SVM machine learning for efficient cross-stack soft error simulation in SoCs.
contributions: SVM-based fast identification and classification of radiation-sensitive circuit nodes
Automated soft error analysis framework spanning the entire software stack
Comprehensive SEU and SET effect databases for SoC platform components
12.78× speedup in simulation with 94.58% accuracy validated on RISC-V
primary_theme: Machine learning-based radiation soft error simulation for SoCs
